onFee(address,address[],uint256[]).details: The vault has already transferred the tokens. The referral share is set aside before any split.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

claimReferral(address[]).notice: Pays the caller's referral rewards in BNB (and QDAO, if any arrived in QDAO). `tokens` lists the fee         tokens whose converted credits should be settled first.

claimableReferral(address,address[]).notice: What `referrer` can claim now, in BNB, counting credits in `tokens` already converted.

convert(address,uint256,address,bytes).notice: Swaps this contract's whole balance of `token` to WBNB through the Swapper (PancakeSwap Smart Router         calldata planned off-chain). When both tokens have Chainlink feeds, the result must be within the         protocol's max slippage of the oracle price.

distributable().notice: BNB available for the split: everything held minus what is owed to referrers.
